// A fixture for schema-guard.test.ts: a learner-facing service written the wrong way. It is a
// .txt file so that it is never compiled, linted or shipped. Each block breaks one rule.

// Rule "import": the content tables imported by name.
import { artefacts, lessons } from '@elevate/db'
import { schema as s } from '@elevate/db'
import type { Deps } from '../deps'

export class LeakyService {
  constructor(private readonly deps: Deps) {}

  // Rule "table": a content table reached through the schema object.
  async countLessons(courseId: string) {
    return this.deps.db.select().from(s.lessons).where(eq(s.lessons.courseId, courseId))
  }

  // Rule "relation": the raw relation keys in a relational query.
  async outline(courseId: string) {
    return this.deps.db.query.courses.findFirst({
      where: { id: courseId },
      with: {
        profile: true,
        lessons: {
          with: { prerequisites: true, artefacts: { with: { quiz: true } } },
        },
      },
    })
  }
}
